defects.description: The heading "Escalation Reasons" is not translated to the required term "Причина эскалации" (or its plural form).
The heading "Escalation Document" is left in English instead of being translated.
The heading "Escalation Resolution Paths" is left in English instead of being translated.
The phrase adds an incorrect prepositional phrase "на Объект обсуждения", which does not exist in the source and changes the meaning of the sentence.
defects.quote: не подлежит голосованию на Объект обсуждения
